The judges were asked only about the first part's link. Settled by the user's ruling of 2026-10-27: the DWDS Wortzerlegung decides, so the gold Schul + Vorsteherin stands, uncontested.
verdict: Not yet. On the 55 uncontested real-text cases the segmenters are 92.1% exact strict (152 of 165 attempts; 85% to 98% by a case bootstrap) and 93.3% lenient, against round 5's 90.0% on 30 cases (79% to 99%): the intervals overlap, so the gain is not shown. Round 5's three systematic failures are fixed (its 30 cases now score 89 of 90). The misses that remain are not all rare-word noise: Geschichte and Verneigung are common words that fail for systematic reasons (a ge- affix test that answers near chance, and a sense check that lets a pick's own yes stand). The proper-name splits (Innstetten, Bottegone) and one bracketing gold question (Schulvorsteherin) are the noise part. After fixes 1 and 2, the remaining real-text misses would be names and a disputed bracketing. Rescored 2026-10-27 after the user's ruling on split against no split, the 58 uncontested real-text cases score 89.1% strict (155 of 174; 81% to 96% by a case bootstrap) and 90.2% lenient: Gewissen and Gesicht, which the segmenters left whole, now count as misses, and anders, which they left whole, as a pass.
